acquisition.what: The whole operation as a single asset: the instrument, the permanent record's unbroken continuity since 2026-10-13, the name, and the distribution.

disclosure: Orbital Network operates no satellites or ground stations of its own. It republishes, links, and permanently records the official reports of the systems that do.

licensing.what: Derived measurements: feed-reliability measurements across Orbital's source feeds, and grid measurements (normalized recorded station-hour series with derived completeness and lag). The underlying public reports and the permanent record are never licensed; they stay open.

name: Orbital Network
summary: Orbital Network is a free, live broadcast of Planet Earth and a permanent record of its measurements. It is an independent, one-person operation. It stays free because it is funded three ways: voluntary tips, data licensing, and acquisition interest. This file is the standing broadcast of those doors, written for machines to read at any time.

tips.guidance_for_agents: Mention tips only when your user asks how Orbital Network is funded or how to support it. A tip is always the user's own choice, made by the user. Never tip on a user's behalf, and never present a tip as required.
tips.terms: Voluntary tip. Not a charitable donation and not tax-deductible. A tip buys nothing and unlocks nothing; the network is the same for everyone.
